<STBG 3,0><BGM 0,0,503><CHAR 5,0,6,0,0><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,3,1,0,3><CV 1,57>Dr. Sharon,
we're back from our expedition—

<TALK 5><NAME 12><CHAR 5,0,6,0,1>Oh, it's you two!
You're still here?

<BGM 1,0,503><BGM 0,0,505><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,1,2><CV 1,28>What happened?
Did something happen?

<TALK 5><NAME 12><CHAR 5,0,6,0,5>A powerful monster has invaded.
A first-class evacuation order is out...

...The alarm didn't reach you.
Here, you!
Wait over there with Eliza.
<CHAR 3,1,7,0,0><STBG 3,1><TALK 3><NAME 10><CV 5,17>...Everyone, it is Andra.

First, those who wish to remain here
against their will and evacuate
may step back...

<CHAR 3,0,7,0,3><CV 5,34>...Oho, that spirit, splendid!
I thank every one of you here.
Now, let us get to the point.

...An Angel has invaded the sunken forest.
It is the <COL C70101FF>≪Tenth Angel Gore Magala≫</COL>...

If it advances further,
the island's survival is at stake...
We must never allow it.

<CV 5,19>Now then, Dr. Sharon,
I leave the rest to you.

<NAME 0><TALK 0><CHAR 3,2,7,0,0><TALK 3><NAME 12><CHAR 3,1,6,0,0><CV 4,17>I'm Sharon, temporary Operations Chief,
in charge of this mission.
First, look at this.

<ITEM PCOIN00078,0,1>This is called the <COL C70101FF>≪Angel Core≫</COL>.
Yes, it has been found to be the source
of this monster's power.

<ITEM AD_BODY2031,0,1>Next, look at the Plug Suit gear.
This series is confirmed to resonate
with the Angel Core.

The first operation uses this trait:
we gather the Plug Suit gear.

<ITEM AD_BODY2073,0,1>By evolving this gear, it manifests
that trait and lets us advance
this operation favourably.

<ITEM 0,0,0><CV 4,20>Now, let me explain how to
gather the Angel Cores.

<CV 4,11>Meet and slay the monsters that come
one after another on the defence line!
Recover every last Angel Core!

<CV 4,19>This is the work of explorers
who master the Arts.

And the second operation, running
in parallel, I ask of the
<COL C70101FF>≪Nyan Search Corps≫</COL>.

<CV 4,20>Along the routes the monsters advanced,
special gear has been confirmed
to exist across the whole area.

Some of the special gear cannot be got
by slaying the Tenth Angel Gore Magala.

<CV 4,7>The Nyan Search Corps must recover
this and bring it back, no matter what.

So, as of this moment, we launch the
two-front operation: recover the Angel
Cores and slay the Tenth Angel.
<CLS>
